caption:
You earn more. No rest? (1 Timothy 6:9–10)

Not money but “the love of money” is a root of all kinds of evil. In the hearth, money warms; loose in the house of the heart, it burns — its owner first.

The question isn't how much you have, but where your fire is right now. Only one Master gave Himself as a ransom for all (2:6).
